title: Guided migrations
subtitle: One resumable run per source team and target server: preflight, import, data, certificates, verification and cutover, with a gate and an approval at every step that needs one.

list.activeOnly: Only runs that are still live
list.empty: Connect a Coolify or Dokploy source in Import, review the plan, then choose Run guided migration. Start with a dry run: it writes nothing outside the run's own records.
list.hint: A run is driven by the hub but needs you at the gates: the source-host command, the freeze, the verification approval and the point of no return.

rollback.UNDOABLE: Fully undoable before the point of no return
rollback.LOSSY_AFTER_PONR: After this, only a lossy reverse exists

mode.copyHint: The source keeps running as a second system. Nothing on it is removed.
mode.takeoverHint: Tugra replaces the source. After finalizing, the source can be stopped (never deleted) in a separate, typed step.

topology.two-boxHint: Tugra runs on its own server. Traffic moves by changing DNS.
topology.swap-proxyHint: Tugra runs beside the source on the same host. Traffic moves by swapping which proxy owns ports 80 and 443; DNS is not touched.

hint.migrator-reported: The migrator on the source host reported this. The hub could not check it independently.
hint.operator-attested: You confirmed this by hand. Nothing checked it.

PREFLIGHT.title: Preflight
PREFLIGHT.desc: Checks the plan, the target server, certificates, DNS access and disk. Reads only.

IMPORT.title: Import configuration
IMPORT.desc: Creates the apps, databases and services on the target from the reviewed plan. Undoable.

DNS_PREPARE.title: Prepare DNS
DNS_PREPARE.desc: Lowers record TTLs now so the later change takes effect quickly. Waits for the old TTL to expire.

DATA_SEED.title: Rehearse data copy
DATA_SEED.desc: A non-disruptive first pass: inventory, speed test, object seed. Optional.

FREEZE.title: Freeze the source
FREEZE.desc: Opens the downtime window by stopping the source writers. The source stays stopped after a complete copy.

DATA_FINAL.title: Final data copy
DATA_FINAL.desc: The last, complete copy of volumes, databases and objects, then verification.

REMAP_ENV.title: Re-point environment
REMAP_ENV.desc: Rewrites references to source databases so apps use the Tugra ones.

DEPLOY_DARK.title: Deploy dark
DEPLOY_DARK.desc: Starts the databases and apps on the target without public traffic.

TLS_PREISSUE.title: Issue certificates
TLS_PREISSUE.desc: Prepares valid certificates before traffic moves.

VERIFY.title: Verify and approve
VERIFY.desc: Parity and runtime checks, then your typed approval of exactly what was verified.

CUTOVER.title: Cutover
CUTOVER.desc: Moves production traffic to Tugra. This is the point of no return for stateful hosts.

OBSERVE.title: Observe
OBSERVE.desc: Watches the moved hosts for a while before finishing.

FINALIZE.title: Finalize
FINALIZE.desc: Restores the original TTLs, writes the report and revokes temporary access.

DECOMMISSION.title: Decommission source
DECOMMISSION.desc: Takeover only, never automatic: stops the source containers and prints removal commands. Tugra deletes nothing.

next.title: What I am waiting for
next.timerDue: The wait is over; the hub continues on its next tick.
next.failedHint: A failed step is not final. Retry it once the cause is fixed, or abort the run to put the source back in charge.

actions.startBody: The hub begins with preflight and imports the configuration onto the target. Nothing touches production traffic until the verification approval.
actions.promoteBody: A new real run is created from the same reviewed inputs. The plan is checked again and the source must still match.
actions.pauseBody: Forward progress stops. Nothing is undone and nothing is rolled back.

banner.dryRunBody: It projects what each step would do and writes nothing outside the run's own records.
banner.dryRunBlocked: {blocks} item(s) would stop a real run and {unknown} could not be checked.
banner.dryRunClean: Nothing would stop a real run ({warns} warning(s)).
banner.ponrBefore: Before the point of no return you can abort: the source becomes authoritative again and nothing is deleted.
banner.ponrPastBody: Abort is no longer possible. You can finish the run, or reverse it; a reverse can lose data written to Tugra after the cutover.

ponr.title: Point of no return
ponr.body: Approving lets the hub route production traffic of stateful apps to Tugra. From then on the source no longer receives their writes and abort is refused. Only a reverse remains, and it can lose data Tugra wrote after the switch.

approval.dataRisk: I understand stateful data may be lost if this is reversed after traffic has moved.
approval.expires: This approval is valid for {minutes} minutes. After that it must be given again.
approval.approvePonr: Approve and pass the point of no return

issue.stale: What you reviewed has changed since you opened this form. Review the new state before approving; the approval is bound to what you saw.
issue.nameMismatch: Type the names exactly as shown.
issue.nameUnavailable: A name needed for confirmation is not known to the hub, so this cannot be confirmed here.

confirm.none: No name is needed to confirm.
confirm.runId: Type the run id to confirm.
confirm.targetServer: Type the target server name to confirm.
confirm.targetServerAndHost: Type the target server name, then the source host, to confirm.
confirm.sourceHost: Type the source host to confirm.

command.intro: This step runs on the source host. The hub mints a short-lived migration token and shows the command once.
command.shownOnce: Shown once: copy it now. It carries a live token.

attest.title: Confirm this was done?
attest.body: You are confirming by hand: {what}. The run records it as attested by you, not as verified by the hub.

attach.hint: Object storage copies keep their credentials in Migrate objects. Create one there, then attach its id; the run only drives and observes it.
attach.label: Object migration id

skip.title: Skip this step?
skip.body: The step is optional. Skipping it leaves its checks unrun.

session.body: The source session expired. Enter the source API token again to continue. It is stored encrypted by the hub and never shown again.
session.hint: Sent to the hub only; the page does not keep it.

inputs.title: Owner inputs
inputs.desc: Answers the run may need. An unanswered input blocks only the step that needs it.
inputs.acmeEmailHint: Required for certificates and the cutover. Earlier steps run without it.
inputs.allowBindHint: Off by default: apps with bind mounts are refused rather than copied from an unknown path.
inputs.allowLiveShapeProbe: Allow a read-only live probe of the source API
inputs.allowLiveShapeProbeHint: Lets the hub read the source API to learn its shapes. Off by default.
inputs.sourceControllerHint: Manual prints the steps and records your attestation. API or agent let the hub stop and restart the recorded source containers.

window.note: There is a window: the source is frozen until the first moved host is verified. The estimate comes from measured sizes and speeds and is replaced by the measured number.

recovery.title: Abort and recovery
recovery.desc: Each action says what it does. Nothing here deletes source data.
recovery.abortBody: Before the point of no return: puts the source back in charge. Cancels transfers, revokes tokens, restarts the recorded source containers (or lists them for you), restores TTLs and stops the Tugra copies. Deletes no data.
recovery.abortConfirm: The source becomes authoritative again and the Tugra copies are left stopped. No data is deleted.
recovery.abortRefused: The point of no return has been reached, so abort is refused. Reverse is the only way back.
recovery.cleanupBody: After an abort: removes the resources the run created on Tugra. Resources holding data need an explicit opt-in and their names.
recovery.cleanupConfirm: Removes the Tugra-side resources this run created. The source is not touched.
recovery.includeData: Also remove resources that hold data
recovery.dataNames: Type the name of each data-holding resource to remove, one per line
recovery.reverseBody: After the point of no return: restores DNS from the ledger, or swaps the proxy back. Data Tugra wrote after the switch is not carried back; dump it to the source yourself.
recovery.reverseConfirm: Traffic goes back to the source. Writes Tugra accepted since the cutover can be lost. Nothing syncs backwards.
recovery.ackLoss: I understand data written to Tugra after the cutover can be lost.
recovery.decommissionBody: Takeover only. Stops the source containers and prints removal commands. Tugra deletes nothing on the source.
recovery.decommissionConfirm: The source containers are stopped, not removed. Removal commands are printed for you to run.

events.title: Events
events.error: The event log could not be refreshed. Retrying.

report.title: Report
report.notYet: The report appears when the run has finished or failed.

drawer.bypass: These are the operation's own panels. Acting here by hand bypasses the guided run's gates and approvals.

launch.title: Run guided migration
launch.desc: Let the hub drive the whole migration with gates and approvals, using this reviewed plan. The manual apply above stays available.
launch.dialogDesc: The run freezes this reviewed plan and the choices made above. Start with a dry run to see what would happen; it writes nothing outside the run's own records.
launch.targetHint: The run puts the imported resources on this server. One live run per target server.
launch.dryRunHint: Projects every step and ends without changing anything. You can promote it to a real run afterwards.
launch.acmeHint: Optional now. Certificates and the cutover are blocked until it is set.
launch.observeHint: How long to watch moved hosts before finishing. 0 to skip.
launch.observeInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 4320.

errors.approval-stale: What you approved no longer matches the current state. Review it again.
errors.run-past-ponr: The point of no return has been reached, so this is no longer possible. Use reverse.
errors.human-confirmation-required: This approval must be given by a person in the panel.

codes.run_promoted: Dry run promoted to a real run.
codes.run_aborted: Run aborted; the source is authoritative again.
codes.run_auth-lost: The run's owner lost the permissions it needs, so it was paused.
codes.run_recovered: The hub restarted and picked the run back up.
codes.step_post-gate-failed: The step finished but its verification did not pass.
codes.step_internal-error: An internal error stopped this step. Retry it; the hub log has details.
codes.approval_void: A stored approval no longer matches what it was given for, so it was voided.
